artifact.summary: Abstained: the recycled-coin flip operator as a function of the memory parameter m is not given in the abstract or the specification. The coin dimension and the initial states are also unspecified. A circuit would have to invent the central operation, so no code is generated.

equation_mapping.explanation: This is the Cesaro-average definition of the time-averaged distribution. It is classical post-processing over many circuit runs and is not a unitary operation, so it is not part of build_circuit.

This is a claimed property of the averaged distribution (the uniform limit). It is a result to be checked after simulation, not a construction to implement, and the conditions under which it holds are unspecified.

specification_changes.change: Scope narrowed to nothing: no circuit construction is implemented.
specification_changes.reason: The m-dependent recycled-coin operator, the coin dimension, and the shift details beyond a generic coined walk are missing. Implementing a generic Hadamard-coin walk would misrepresent the recycled-coin model.

unresolved_issues: Explicit recycled-coin coin operator as a function of m is not specified.
Coin dimension and initial states studied are not specified.
Which parameter values give non-uniform behavior is not specified.
Relationship to the other memory-based quantum walk is not specified.
Handling of cycle sizes N that are not powers of two in a qubit encoding is not specified.
